With a holding of approximately 97.1%, ESB is majority owned by the Irish Government. The remaining approximate 2.9% is held by the trustees of an Employee Share Ownership Plan. As a strong, diversified, vertically integrated utility, ESB operates right across the electricity market: from generation, through transmission and distribution, to supply. In addition, ESB extracts further value at certain points along this chain: supplying gas, using our networks to carry fibre for telecommunications, developing electric vehicle public charging infrastructure and more. ESB is a leading Irish utility focused on providing excellent customer service and maintaining our financial strength. We have a regulated asset base of approximately €12 billion with 30% of electricity generation capacity in the all-island market.

These phases describe the implementation sequence only and shall not be interpreted as payment milestones.

 

4. Invitation for Expressions of Interest

The Green Plan now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Consultant brochures may also be included in the Expression of Interest (EOI).

 

5. Evaluation Criteria

Expressions of Interest will be evaluated using a 100-point scoring system based on the following criteria and weights:

Criterion 1: General experience of the firm (30/100)

This criterion assesses the firm’s overall experience and track record, including years of relevant experience and the number and type of websites successfully delivered.  Criterion 2: Experience in Similar Assignments within the last 10 years (25/100)

This criterion assesses the firm's experience in successfully delivering assignments of similar nature, scope and complexity to the required se

s currently reflected in the REOI.

Criterion 4: Experience with Government Institutions, Donor-Funded Projects and NGOs within the last 10 years (20/100)

This criterion assesses the firm's experience in providing similar services to government institutions, donor-funded projects, international organizations, and non-governmental organizations (NGOs). It evaluates the firm's familiarity with the working environment, requirements and standards typically associated with such organizations.

The firm shall provide relevant portfolios and supporting documents to substantiate the information provided under the above evaluation criteria. Such documents may include, where applicable, website links, project references, completion certificates, client references, or other evidence demonstrating the Applicant’s experience and qualifications.

The Expression of Interest should not exceed 50 pages.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (February 2025), which set forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. POLITIQUE SUR LA PRIORISATION DES FOURNISSEURS CANADIENS ET CONTENU CANADIEN Le présent appel d’offres est ouvert uniquement aux fournisseurs canadiens AUTORISATIONS DE TÂCHES L’ensemble du contrat subséquent sera un contrat à autorisation de tâches. Le contrat avec autorisations de tâches (AT) est une méthode d'approvisionnement de services selon laquelle l'ensemble ou une portion des travaux sont réalisés « selon la demande ». Dans le cadre de contrats avec AT, le travail à réaliser peut être défini, mais la nature et les échéances précises des services, des activités et des produits livrables requis ne sont connus qu'au moment où le service est demandé pendant la durée du contrat. L'AT est un outil administratif structuré grâce auquel la Couronne autorise un entrepreneur à effectuer les travaux « selon la demande », conformément aux modalités du contrat. Les AT ne sont pas des contrats individuels. PROGRAMME DES MARCHANDISES CONTRÔLÉES La présente demande d’offres est assujettie au Programme des marchandises contrôlées (PMC). La Loi sur la production de défense définit les marchandises canadiennes contrôlées comme certains biens énumérés dans la Liste des marchandises d’exportation contrôlée du Canada, un règlement adopté en v

e tout marché avec les fournisseurs. Les documents peuvent être présentés dans l’une ou l’autre des langues officielles du Canada. ************************** DESCRIPTION Public Works and Government Services Canada (PWGSC), on behalf of the Defence Research and Development Canada (DRDC) – Valcartier Research Centre (VRC), is issuing this Solicitation of Offers for the acquisition of specialized modelling, simulation and software development services in support of research, development, analysis and evaluation of military systems and capabilities at Defence Research and Development Canada(DRDC) – Valcartier Research Centre (VRC). The Scope of Work covers the following points: · Task 1 – Create digital models · Task 2 – Validate and verify digital models or software components · Task 3 - Analysis, modification or creation of software components · Task 4 – Support execution of the software components in a series of simulations · Task 5 – Analyze simulations or software components · Task 6 – Collect data from real systems · Task 7 – Maintain software capability and support to partners for the knowledge transfer PERIODE OF THE CONTRACT The Period of the Contract is from date of Contract to March 31 ,2032, inclusive.
